source_snapshot.title: Ras Al Khaimah reopens seven beaches after precautionary closures over oil spill concerns
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Ras Al Khaimah has announced the reopening of seven public and resort beaches across the emirate, nearly three weeks after authorities ordered their closure as a precautionary measure amid concerns over an offshore oil spill.The Public Services Department confirmed on Wednesday that Flamingo Beach, Dahan Beach, Al Maireedh Beach and Al Rams Corniche have reopened to the public..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..The reopening also covers beaches at three major resorts: Anantara Mina Al Arab Resort, InterContinental Ras Al Khaimah Mina Al Arab Resort and Spa, and The Cove Rotana Resort.The department said further announcements regarding the reopening of the remaining beaches would be issued gradually through its official communication channels.It urged residents and visitors to comply with instructions and safety guidelines issued by the relevant authorities to ensure public safety.The announcement follows a decision on October 24 to close all beaches across Ras Al Khaimah until further notice, in coordination with Ras Al Khaimah Police.The precautionary closures came amid concerns over an oil spill from a tanker off the UAE's northern coast, which also prompted restrictions on beaches in neighbouring Umm Al Quwain and Sharjah.The UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment confirmed at the time that specialist teams were working to contain the spill and assess its environmental impact.On October 30, authorities announced that the oil leak had been stopped, with no further leakage detected. They also reported a significant decline in marine pollution, while monitoring and clean-up operations continued along affected coastal areas.The ministry clarified that precautionary beach closures did not necessarily indicate that pollution had reached every affected location.The latest announcement marks a phased restoration of public access to Ras Al Khaimah's coastline, although restrictions remain in place at beaches not yet cleared for reopening.Residents and tourists have been advised to check official announcements before visiting other coastal areas and continue observing all safety instructions..Ras Al Khaimah closes all public beaches until further notice.Khor Fakkan beach closed after oil spill detected along coast.Full list of UAE beach closures in Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain and reasons including oil spill.UAE oil spill: Beaches in Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain remain closed

claims.claim: Ras Al Khaimah reopened seven public and resort beaches after nearly three weeks of closure due to oil spill concerns.
The reopened beaches include Flamingo Beach, Dahan Beach, Al Maireedh Beach, and Al Rams Corniche.
Beaches at three major resorts were also reopened.
The beach closures were ordered on October 24 as a precautionary measure after an oil spill from a tanker.
The oil leak was stopped on October 30, pollution declined, and cleanup and monitoring operations continue.
Authorities urge compliance with safety instructions and monitoring of official announcements.

summary_ru: 🏖 Рас-эль-Хайма открыла семь пляжей после закрытия из-за разлива нефти В эмирате Рас-эль-Хайма вновь открыты семь общественных и курортных пляжей, закрытых почти на три недели из-за опасений разлива нефти у побережья. Среди них пляжи Flamingo, Dahan, Al Maireedh и Al Rams Corniche, а также пляжи трёх крупных курортов. 📅 Закрытие пляжей было введено 24 октября как мера предосторожности после утечки нефти с танкера. 30 октября утечка была остановлена, загрязнение снизилось, продолжаются работы по очистке и мониторингу. Власти призывают соблюдать инструкции безопасности и следить за официальными сообщениями.
